plan_review.notes: rubber-duck agent plan-review-slice2 raised 3 blocking + 1 should-fix. All resolved: (1) documented reader-side scaling as the shipping design in spec .specify/specs/entity-physics.md and ADR 0044 §Weight as knockback denominator, so future writers understand they must keep raw values (blocker 1); (2) tightened check-weight-coverage.ts to require per-kind non-vacuity (Enemy>0 AND Player>0 AND Prop>0) rather than the trivially-satisfied total-count check that Player alone would pass (blocker 2); (3) ran scripts/agent/perf/winrate-sweep.ts on seeds 1-10 × 3 weapons for both Slice 1 baseline and Slice 2 — see files/sweep-slice2-summary.txt and handoff (blocker 3); (4) froze enemy weight against the sizeScale cosmetic RNG in initializeEnemyAppearance so weight is a first-class gameplay dial and not a hidden ±10% variance on knockback distance (should-fix 1).
